title: A confident report, an audited rate
hook: Compare a reported chance with a different stipulated audit rate, using unchanged payoffs.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to keep stated confidence distinct from independently justified correctness rates

misconception: Expressed certainty itself determines the correctness probability that should enter a decision calculation.
objective: Keep stated confidence distinct from independently justified correctness rates.
